title: Cubic solver exponent certificate
statement: The cubic linear solver backend has an exponent certificate with exponent $3$: its coefficient is $2(c_D+c_R+2)^3$, and for every finite encoded coordinate set, equation list, and natural numbers $b,d,c_D,c_R$ with $0<b$, coordinate count at most $c_D b^d$, and equation count at most $c_R b^d$, its work is at most $2(c_D+c_R+2)^3 b^{3d}$.
hypotheses_covered: The cubic solver backend and its cubic exponent are fixed
The coordinate set is finite and encoded
The coordinate count is at most $c_D b^d$
The equation count is at most $c_R b^d$
caveat: The certificate is defined using an upstream work-bound result for the cubic backend that is not included in the payload.
